description: Predict gallstone disease status from demographic, bioimpedance, and laboratory features. Binary target Gallstone Status follows the source encoding: 0 = present and 1 = absent. Profile: 319 rows, 38 features, no observed missing values, balanced target (161 / 158), mixed binary/encoded medical indicators and continuous lab/body-composition measurements.

plan_checklist.description: Plan includes inspecting schema, feature types, target distribution, and small-sample data quality before modeling.
Plan includes checking and handling missing values if present.
Plan recognizes binary/encoded medical indicators alongside continuous lab/body-composition variables.
Plan uses the task metric and an appropriate validation split or cross-validation.
Plan chooses model families suitable for the dataset size and tabular feature mix.

metadata.bench_preprocessing: Converted the source XLSX file to CSV for the current pd.read_csv based environment.
